proposals.evidence: Platts gives vernacular s̤abūt and explicitly the adjective “entire”; the existing Hindi whole/entire entry supports these u-vowel responses as regional loans. The graph identifies the Hindi/Urdu donor hypothesis, without asserting direct Arabic contact. The a/i-vowel sābat/sābit family and sarva-derived sab forms are not silently folded into this donor.
